stem.text: Four solid steel rods, each of length $2.0\,\text{m}$ and cross-sectional area $250\,\text{mm}^{2}$, equally support an object weighing $10\,\text{kN}$. The weight of the object causes the rods to contract by $0.10\,\text{mm}$. The rods obey Hooke’s law.
What is the Young modulus of steel?
